definitions.short: the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture , (or mongrel race)
definitions.full: H6154. ereb I. עֵ֫רֶב noun masculine Exod 12:38 mixture, mixed company ; — heterogeneous body attached to a people; to Israel 12:38 (E), Neh 13:3 ; to Egyptians Jer 25:20 ( ᵑ9 joins to 25:19 , so Gie); to Chaldeans 50:37 ; in 25:24 strike out הָעֶרֶב ֗֗֗ וְאֵת as doublet (so Gie, compare ᵐ5 ); in 1Kin 10:15 read עֲרָב (as || 2Chr 9:14 , so Benz Kit and others); Ezek 30:5 read probably id. (Co). II. עֵ֫רֶב noun [masculine] woof (as mixed , interwoven, with warp); — Lev 13:48 + 8t. 13 (all opposed to שְׁתִי warp ), compare GFM PAOS 1889, clxxviii .
definitions.rootNote: or עֶרֶב ; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article prefix), from 6148 ;
